referenceProvenance.richter: Richter (2012), Goal-oriented error estimation for fluid-structure interaction problems, Tables 5 and 6: the source values 1.327 N and 5.924e-5 m are extrapolations from the finest three of five finite-element levels, not single-level values; the commonly quoted 1.33 N and 5.95e-5 m are rounded benchmark values, and approximately 1% reference accuracy was claimed. Richter places the solid at x=0.4..0.5 m, samples A=(0.45,0.15,0.15) m and prescribes peak inlet speed 0.3 m/s, whereas this solids4foam form places the solid at x=0.45..0.55 m, samples the upstream face A=(0.45,0.15,-0.15) m and prescribes peak speed 0.2 m/s; it is therefore not an exact problem match
referenceProvenance.tukovic: Tukovic et al. (2018), OpenFOAM Finite Volume Solver for Fluid-Solid Interaction: same solids4foam code lineage
